files.title: File:"It 'piers' something's missing." Astoria, OR, Shoreline 9-1-13b (10004069576).jpg
files.author: inkknife_2000 (7.5 million views +)
files.caption:
(1 in a multiple picture set)
I was surprised to see this scene on the Norhwest American Coast, as it looked so much like similar places along the East Coast of our country.  I liked the abandoned pilings from long-gone piers, and the waterfowl sitting on them. I let my mind go back to when Astoria was one of the major ports in the USA.  I could almost see the masted ships tied up at the docks which are now gone.
